profile.headline: Software Engineer  |  Building capable teams and systems
profile.jobTitle: Member of Technical Staff - Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Software engineering leader experienced in designing, developing and operating distributed systems, with an emphasis on security and network infrastructure.

Maintain high standards, lead with integrity, assume there’s something to learn from everyone.

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff - Software Engineer
Engineering Manager
positions.description:
Software Engineering Manager of the Threat Defense team. My team is responsible for reducing Cruise's cybersecurity risk by quickly detecting and responding to active threats against its data, systems, and passengers.

In my role, I design software systems, mentor and technically guide senior engineers, interview and hire, and also define the roadmap for our software-driven detection and response program. I grew my team from 2 to 8 engineers in a healthy manner over a period of 18 months.

The core pillars of my team's work include:
* Developing and maintaining data pipelines to procure security-relevant data into our data warehouse.
* Creating innovative operating system-level software to generate telemetry necessary for detecting attacker behavior.
* Designing anomalous behavioral detections in SQL that can operate across a wide variety of datasets.
* Implementing automated incident response capabilities to expedite both the confirmation and remediation of active incidents.
positions.insights: Skills: Leadership · Cybersecurity · Engineering Management · Backend · Go · Data Engineering
